    start_airport_city="Atlanta",

)

# Save the outbound flight results
save_to_cache(key="flights_outbound", value=flights_outbound)

# Search for return flights from St. Louis to Atlanta
flights_return = search_flights(
    start_airport_city="St. Louis",
    end_airport_city="Atlanta",
    departure_date=[return_date],
    flight_class=["economy"]
)

# Save the return flight results
save_to_cache(key="flights_return", value=flights_return)

# Search for hotels in Downtown St. Louis

hotels = search_hotels(
    city="St. Louis",
    neighborhood=["Downtown"],
    checkin_date=hotel_checkin_dates,
    checkout_date=hotel_checkout_dates,
    budget=70,
    has_free_parking=True
)

# Save the hotel results
